name: architrave
description: Spec-driven development control plane for coding agents. Every task starts from a repository requirements file with testable acceptance; work, child sessions, owner corrections and hand-offs are traced to REQ ids, and done means accepted with evidence. Adds durable resumable Runs, bounded multi-session supervision, deterministic and judge-gated verification, design-, contract- and runtime-grounded specialist roles, and a self-improving learning loop.
